t003-user-loop-skip.note: User reports it loops fine and skip also worked. Audio-media fixture, precise boundaries, persistence and snap were not explicitly specified. Range rendering subsequently changed in T004.

t006-user-resize.note: User reports extension worked well; rejected custom held-hand appearance and requested four-way move cursor. Detailed modes/boundaries/current visuals remain pending.

t009-simple-icons.note: User-directed simpler toolbar appearance. Two headless toolbar checks and build pass; synthetic preview inspected. Live appearance pending; transport-v4 denominator unchanged.

t010-hover-and-menu-font.note: User-requested consistent hover feedback and clearer menus. Release build and formatting pass; no runtime or user acceptance claimed. No transport-v4 denominator change.

requirements.outcome: Normal ruler drag continuously seeks with the marker under the pointer.
requirements.implementation_note: Current ruler handlers use a shared pointer-to-beats transform; actual headless seek/release tests pass. Live continuous alignment remains pending.

requirements.outcome: On release the cursor snaps according to the specified active grid settings.
requirements.implementation_note: T008 uses one selected-grid resolver: Bar=project measure, Beat=one quarter-note beat, Use Quantize=selected straight/triplet/dotted duration; Snap off is free. Actual popup and seek/range gesture tests pass. Live acceptance pending.

requirements.outcome: Horizontal seeking and vertical anchor-preserving zoom operate simultaneously.
requirements.implementation_note: T005 removes exclusive direction locking. Each captured update applies vertical anchor-preserving zoom, independent accumulated edge scroll, and pointer seeking through the resulting transform. Both initial movement directions and project-start anchor restoration pass headless interaction tests; live alignment pending.

Middle drag starts in ruler or canvas, avoids a first-press jump, pans both axes and stops without content mutation/seek. T007 uses the native four-way held cursor instead of the rejected custom hand. Headless interaction passes; current live review pending.

requirements.outcome: Top ruler pencil drag left to right creates a purple repeat region.
requirements.implementation_note: Top 7px ruler strip previews/commits a purple left-to-right cycle range, with pencil cursor, captured release, cancellation and edge scroll. One persistent range; headless handler tests pass, live visual review pending. User confirmed functional loop/skip operation on T003. T004 adds monochrome pencil, inward corner flags, matching active Cycle button colors and full-height faint range tint; current visual acceptance pending. T005 adds hand-driven translation over the existing range; original drawing begins outside it. Current interaction review pending; historical T003 functional user evidence remains in the evidence registry.

requirements.outcome: Top ruler pencil drag right to left creates a red/orange skip region.
requirements.implementation_note: Top ruler right-to-left drag commits orange Skip mode with ascending stored bounds. Handler tested headlessly, live behavior pending. User confirmed functional loop/skip operation on T003. T004 adds monochrome pencil, inward corner flags, matching active Cycle button colors and full-height faint range tint; current visual acceptance pending. T005 adds hand-driven translation over the existing range; original drawing begins outside it. Current interaction review pending; historical T003 functional user evidence remains in the evidence registry.

requirements.outcome: Range endpoint snap behavior matches the separately confirmed specification.
requirements.implementation_note: T008 endpoints use the shared selected interval, with free positions when Snap is off. Settings/defaults persist and selected-grid draw/resize tests pass. Exact reference endpoint policies remain unmeasured.

requirements.outcome: Loop enable changes actual audible playback and cursor behavior at cycle boundaries.
requirements.implementation_note: Cycle state and core mode reach the audio plan. The callback applies looping per frame; offline buffer-boundary test passes. Listening and live cursor/audio agreement pending. User reports functional loop and skip success on T003; audible fixture and precise cursor/audio boundary agreement remain unmeasured, so full runtime requirement acceptance is pending.

requirements.outcome: Actual playback and cursor obey the confirmed skip-region semantics.
requirements.implementation_note: Skip mode jumps [start,end) to end per audio frame when Cycle is enabled; no-engine fallback follows the same mode. Offline boundary test passes. Reference semantics and audible/live acceptance pending. User reports functional loop and skip success on T003; audible fixture and precise cursor/audio boundary agreement remain unmeasured, so full runtime requirement acceptance is pending.

requirements.outcome: Both edges scroll while held during drag, stop away from edges, and retain pointer alignment.
requirements.implementation_note: Existing seek edge scroll retained; range drawing also uses elapsed-time edge scroll. Pure held-edge checks pass; live regression pending.

requirements.outcome: Playback-follow scrolling obeys its explicit enable/mode specification.
requirements.implementation_note: autoscroll_enabled is persisted and its toolbar toggles it; no playback-follow consumer found.

requirements.outcome: Ruler label and tick density adapts to zoom without changing snap resolution.
requirements.implementation_note: T007 preserves globally anchored power-of-two bar strides and refines to quarter/eighth/sixteenth grid ticks as space permits. Bars+Beats fractional labels appear according to measured label width; actual emitted label text is tested headlessly through finer and coarser zooms. Shared zoom range is now 0.25-256. Snap remains independent. Live review/reference thresholds pending.

requirements.outcome: Ruler/grid use available width and horizontal navigation continues beyond bar 50.
requirements.implementation_note: Timeline runway now grows with range bounds and current navigation as well as cursor/material; available width is retained. Live regression pending.

requirements.outcome: Pinned headers, scrollbars and ruler right-click behavior remain correct without invented tooltips.
requirements.implementation_note: One ruler response retains its context menu; a top range zone and lower seek zone prevent gesture conflicts. No ruler tooltip added. Live pinned-header/scrollbar/menu regression pending.

requirements.outcome: Hand dragging the existing ruler range translates both bounds, preserving its duration, mode and grab offset.
requirements.implementation_note: Rigid translation preserves fractional length, mode and grab offset, with Bar-delta snap and project clamps. T007 removes rejected custom fist: native pointing hand on hover, native four-way Move while held. Headless actual range-move regression passes; current live review pending. T008 replaces fixed Bar spacing with the shared selected interval; rigid moves snap delta, resizing snaps the moving boundary. Selected 1/8 gesture regression passes.

requirements.outcome: Dragging either corner triangle extends or shortens only that boundary while retaining the opposite boundary and Loop/Skip mode.
requirements.implementation_note: Handle capture preserves grab offset; snapped/free resizing respects project bounds and prevents crossing/empty ranges. Preview, release commit and Undo share existing range path. Tests cover both handles and both modes; live behavior and reference crossing semantics pending. User reported extension works on T006; resize logic is retained in T007. Detailed current-build acceptance remains pending. T008 replaces fixed Bar spacing with the shared selected interval; rigid moves snap delta, resizing snaps the moving boundary. Selected 1/8 gesture regression passes.

requirements.outcome: Grid Type and Quantize Type menus choose and persist the interval used by enabled ruler/range snapping.
requirements.implementation_note: Bar/Beat/Use Quantize menus and 1/1-1/128 straight/triplet/dotted values are functional. Actual popup selections, shared seek/draw/move/resize snap, OPR v17 round-trip and legacy defaults pass headless tests. Full reference menu layout and live user check pending. T009 makes implemented field captions/arrows high contrast, verified from emitted text in both themes; actual popup/menu regressions pass. Live toolbar appearance pending.

dirty-state.description: Seeking/view activity does not create an unintended save prompt.

range-persistence.description: Range content survives native save/reopen and its edits follow documented undo/dirty semantics.

audible-boundaries.description: Cycle and skip execute at correct audio boundaries with cursor/audio agreement.

accepted-ui.description: Affected accepted Mixer and Project controls pass regression checks.
